page.notes: Woodcut initial Q of "Quaestiones" is joined to the word, as printed in the frame. The drop cap E of "Effectus" is joined to the word. Several words are doubtful: "serium" (read as serium[?]; it may be ferium or a similar form) and "serium" in the first paragraph. Line 6 is cut off at the foot of the scan; only "An" is visible, so the rest of the line is not transcribed. The running head is printed with spaced capitals as "DE HOMINIS GRATITVD.". Marginal references are printed as Rom.5.1., Luc.22.32. and Mat.5.16. Small ornamental dots and marks in the margins are not text and are omitted. No catchword or signature is visible.
